Robot stuck among the tables and chairs

2. It is recommended to arrange the tables and chairs neatly to prevent robot from getting stuck.

state.robot_stuck_on_passage:

2. It is recommended to set the narrow passage as a no-go zone to prevent the robot from getting stuck.
The robot is stuck

state.robot_stuck_on_obstacle:

state.robot_stuck_on_pet:

state.robot_stuck_on_slippery_surface:

state.drainage_failed:

state.mop_not_detected:
Mop not detected.

state.mop_holder_error:

state.dock_error:
Dock Error.
Please check the dock and try the following steps:
1. Make sure the hatch is fully closed.
2. Make sure the three groups of mops are placed on the hatch in red-yellow-blue order. If the mops are currently on the transport carrier or washboard, put them back on the hatch in this order and try again.
3. Check for any debris inside the dock. Do not place your hand, robot, or other items in the washboard when switching mops.
state.wash_failed:
Failed to wash dirty mop.
Please check the dock and try the following steps:
1. Please manually attach the mop that needs washing to robot.
2. Please install other dirty mops onto the hatch.
3. Go to the app → Dock Functions → Wash to restart the mop-washing task.
state.robot_stuck_on_curtain:
Robot slips in the curtain area
1. Please move robot away from the curtain area and restart the task.
2. Robot cannot clean this curtain area. It is recommended to remove it.
The robot is stuck
state.edge_mop_stop_rotate:
Edge mop stopped rotating.
Edge mop stopped rotating. Please follow these steps:
1. Check if robot is on a carpet. Friction between the edge mop and carpet may stop it from rotating. Move robot to a non-carpet area and resume cleaning.
2. Check if the edge mop is tangled. If so, remove them and resume cleaning.
state.edge_mop_detached:
Edge mop detached.
Edge mop not detected. Please install it before resuming cleaning.
state.chassis_lift_malfunction:
Chassis lift malfunction.
Chassis lift malfunction. Please restart the task. If the issue persists, contact customer service.
state.mop_cover_error:
Check for any debris near the roller mop and mop cover. Clean the roller mop to prevent the cover from getting stuck. After that, place the robot flat and resume the task. If the issue persists, please contact customer service.
Mop cover error.
state.roller_mop_error:
Check for any debris near the roller mop and mop cover. Clean the roller mop to prevent it from getting stuck. After that, place the robot flat and resume the task. If the issue persists, please contact customer service.
Roller mop error.
state.onboard_water_tank_empty:
Low water level in robot’s clean water box.
Low water level in robot’s clean water box. Please refill promptly.
state.onboard_dirty_water_tank_full:
Robot's used water box is full. Please empty it promptly.
Please take out the box and empty it. Alternatively, you can move robot to the dock for mop-washing (this will also drain the used water).
state.mop_not_installed:
Mop Not Installed.
Please confirm the roller mop is properly installed before starting or resuming the task.
state.fluffing_roller_error:
Fluffing Roller Error.
1. Turn robot over with the bottom facing up. Press the release button on one side of the roller mop to take it out, then clean any debris around it.
2. Press the orange clip and take out the fluffing roller. Clean any hair or debris on it.
3. After cleaning, install the fluffing roller and press the clip firmly. Then install the roller mop, place the robot flat, and resume the task.
If the issue persists, please check more details or contact customer service.
state.blocked_by_obstacle:
Robot blocked by obstacle.
Please check for any obstacles in front of the robot and remove them.
state.robotic_arm_stopped:
Robotic arm stopped.
Please press and hold the Dock button and the Robotic Arm On/Off button to reset before using again.
state.drainage_outlet_filter:
The wastewater outlet filter of robot is clogged.
Please clean the wastewater outlet filter of the robot promptly to ensure smooth water flow.
state.main_wheels_error:
Main wheels error.
Wheel anomaly detected. The cleaning task has been paused. You can try to resume cleaning using the button on robot or via the app. If the issue persists, please contact us for assistance.
